metadata.description: SCALE — Scaffolded Coverage-Aware Learning Engine. A Claude Code plugin that helps a junior engineer build genuine comprehension of a codebase, guided by an LLM-built coverage memory and visualized as a territory map.

plugins.name: scale
plugins.description: Hooks that capture coverage evidence and gate edits into locked territory, skills (scale-map, scale-tutor, scale-settings), /scale-* commands (map, status, study, quiz, review, settings, open), and a bundled `scale` CLI + web map viewer. Self-contained — no monorepo required.
